newsitem.title: CANADA: Abitibi-Price Inc Q3 net profits fall.
newsitem.headline: Abitibi-Price Inc Q3 net profits fall.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
In the third quarter of 1995, Abitibi recorded a C$4 million unusual gain relating to the disposition of assets at a former mill site in Thunder Bay, Ontario.

Note: In the third quarter of 1996, Abitibi took an unusual charge related to flooding at its Kenogami mill in the Saguenay region of Quebec. The cost of business interruption and repairs to operating equipment and buildings was covered under insurance but the deductible and cleaning and repair costs not covered cost C$4 million.

Nine months results for 1996 include pre-tax second quarter restructuring charges of C$28 million related to the conversion to two new thermo-mechanical pulping plants. Before the charges, earnings for the first nine months of 1996 were C$131 million, or C$1.44 per fully diluted common share.
